info.title: Autonodwell API
info.description: Single API for the Autonodwell web app, sales console and future native apps.

delete.description:
Right-to-delete: removes designs and profile, strips personal data from leads.
The (anonymised) lead row is kept so sales reporting totals stay correct.

get.description: Right-to-know: everything we store about the signed-in person, as JSON.

post.description: Step 4 → 'Review with a consultant'. Creates (or updates) the sales lead and syncs it to the CRM.
Manual retry — runs synchronously so the rep sees the result immediately.

AssumptionsIn.title: AssumptionsIn
AssumptionsIn.description: Saving creates a NEW assumption set and activates it (old estimates stay traceable).
